title: Hiring - Salesforce Developer, Admin, Tester, Consultant & Architect
Tosca Automation Tester
description:
We are looking for an experienced Tosca Automation Tester with strong expertise in SAP / S4 HANA automation testing. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in test automation using Tosca and a solid understanding of SAP business processes, test design, execution, and defect management. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts using Tosca. Perform end-to-end automation testing for SAP / S4 HANA applications. Analyze business requirements and create detailed test scenarios and test cases. Execute functional, regression, integration, and system testing. Collaborate with business analysts, developers, and functional teams to understand requirements and testing scope. Identify, log, track, and retest defects using defect management tools. Maintain reusable automation components and optimize automation coverage. Participate in test planning, estimation, and reporting activities. Ensure adherence to QA processes, standards, and best practices. Support CI/CD and automation framework enhancements where applicable. Required Skills 57 years of experience in software testing and automation. Strong hands-on experience with Tricentis Tosca. Experience in SAP automation testing, preferably SAP S/4 HANA. Good understanding of test automation frameworks and testing methodologies. Experience in functional, regression, and integration testing. Knowledge of defect tracking and test management tools. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Preferred Skills Experience with API testing and database validation. Exposure to Agile/Scrum methodologies. Knowledge of CI/CD tools like Jenkins is an added advantage. Tosca certification preferred. Educational Qualification Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.

Key Skills: Tosca Automation,SAP,SAP HANA,Tosca,S4H,Automation Testing,SAP Automation,SAP Automation Testing
